purpose: Defines the canonical architecture, traits, domain models, mathematical token accounting formulas, 6-dimensional trajectory evaluation metrics, single-pass accumulators, 4-engine grader suite, dual-mode execution harness, and CLI interfaces for the Prism evaluation and quality gating platform and the Lumen foundational telemetry engine.
scope: Covers lumen-model (Canonical IR, Turn, ToolIntent, TokenEconomics), lumen-session (SIMD parsers, ClaudeCode, AGY, Codex adapters), lumen-analysis (22 single-pass accumulators), lumen-pattern (petgraph Trajectory DAG & Tarjan SCC cycle detector), prism-core (TaskSpec, VCR Cassettes, Scorecard, WorkspaceSandbox), prism-grader (Deterministic State, Trajectory, Multi-Agent Circuit, Opus Calibrated Judge), prism-cli, lumen-cli, and plugins/prism integration.
non_goals: Mandatory background SQLite daemon dependency for test execution (Prism is 100% stateless).
Synthetic or ungrounded benchmark evaluation without real workspace compilation checks.
Modifying or polluting host repository files during test runs (all trial executions are hermetically isolated in /tmp/ sandboxes).
Heavy web framework or Electron UI packaging in core binaries.

api_surface.name: SessionAdapter
api_surface.signature: pub trait SessionAdapter: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn matches_fingerprint(&self, sample: &str) -> bool; fn capabilities(&self) -> AdapterCapabilities; fn parse_stream<'a>(&self, reader: Box<dyn BufRead + 'a>) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript, IngestionError>; }
api_surface.description: Zero-copy streaming parser interface implemented by ClaudeCodeAdapter, AgyAdapter, and CodexAdapter to project raw JSONL lines into CanonicalTranscript.
error_conditions: IngestionError::MalformedJson if a JSON line cannot be deserialized
IngestionError::UnrecognizedFormat if log sample does not match known provider fingerprint

api_surface.name: RawMessageAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub trait RawMessageAccumulator { type Output: Serialize + Send; fn update_raw(&mut self, message: &serde_json::Value); fn finalize(self) -> Self::Output; }
api_surface.description: Single-pass stream accumulator operating on low-level JSON frames (token usage, model metadata, rate limit health).
error_conditions: Handles missing usage or model fields gracefully without panicking

api_surface.name: EntryAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub trait EntryAccumulator { type Output: Serialize + Send; fn update(&mut self, entry: &CanonicalTurn); fn finalize(self) -> Self::Output; }
api_surface.description: Single-pass stream accumulator operating on normalized semantic turns (timeline, tool transitions, schema citations, self-corrections).
error_conditions: Handles out-of-order timestamps by sorting during finalization

api_surface.name: TrajectoryGraph
api_surface.signature: pub struct TrajectoryGraph { graph: petgraph::graph::DiGraph<ToolNode, CompactString>, last_node: Option<petgraph::graph::NodeIndex> }; impl TrajectoryGraph { pub fn new() -> Self; pub fn push_tool(&mut self, node: ToolNode) -> petgraph::graph::NodeIndex; pub fn detect_circular_loops(&self) -> Vec<CircularLoopAnomaly>; pub fn calculate_efficiency(&self) -> f32; }
api_surface.description: Petgraph-backed Trajectory DAG modeling sequential tool invocations and detecting circular exploration loops via Tarjan Strongly Connected Components.
error_conditions: Emits CircularLoopAnomaly if cycle depth >= 3 and state mutations == 0

api_surface.name: Grader
api_surface.signature: pub trait Grader: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn evaluate(&self, spec: &TaskSpec, transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> Result<AssertionResult, EvaluationError>; }
api_surface.description: Deterministic evaluation assertion interface implemented by RedGreenGrader, TrajectoryGrader, CircuitBreakerGrader, and RubricJudge.
error_conditions: EvaluationError::TaskRunnerFailed if just test or cargo test execution fails
EvaluationError::Timeout if task evaluation exceeds configured timeout_seconds

api_surface.name: ExecutionDriver
api_surface.signature: pub trait ExecutionDriver: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn is_available(&self) -> bool; async fn execute(&self, task: &TaskSpec, sandbox_dir: &std::path::Path) -> Result<CanonicalTranscript, ExecutionError>; }
api_surface.description: Decoupled trial runner interface implemented by ClaudeCliDriver, AgyCliDriver, AnthropicApiDriver, and VcrReplayDriver.
error_conditions: ExecutionError::DriverUnavailable if required CLI binary or API key is not found
ExecutionError::ProcessFailed if subprocess exits with non-zero error status
ExecutionError::CassetteNotFound if VCR replay requested but cassette is missing

api_surface.name: WorkspaceSandbox
api_surface.signature: pub struct WorkspaceSandbox { temp_dir: tempfile::TempDir, pub path: std::path::PathBuf }; impl WorkspaceSandbox { pub fn new(fixture_path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Self, std::io::Error>; pub async fn git_checkout(&self, commit_sha: &str) -> Result<(), std::io::Error>; pub async fn apply_patch(&self, patch: &str) -> Result<(), std::io::Error>; pub async fn run_test_suite(&self) -> Result<bool, std::io::Error>; }
api_surface.description: Hermetic file sandbox creating isolated /tmp/ workspace clones with ephemeral git repositories for test trial execution.
error_conditions: std::io::Error if disk space is exhausted or fixture copying fails
Fails if patch application fails due to conflict

api_surface.name: TokenUsageAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub struct TokenUsageAccumulator { pub input_tokens: u64, pub output_tokens: u64, pub cache_creation_tokens: u64, pub cache_read_tokens: u64, pub turns: u64 }; impl TokenUsageAccumulator { pub fn update_raw(&mut self, message: &serde_json::Value); pub fn finalize(self) -> TokenEconomics; }
api_surface.description: Mathematical token accountant calculating exact USD costs, cache hit ratios, baseline costs, and financial efficiency multipliers.
error_conditions: Silently ignores <synthetic> model tags from internal proxy layers

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN a valid JSONL session file is parsed by lumen-session, THE SYSTEM SHALL project all messages into a CanonicalTranscript with turn indices, tool intents, and token usage in under 50ms per 10MB.
WHEN computing prompt token economics for Claude 3.5 Sonnet, THE SYSTEM SHALL bill uncached input at $3.00/M, cache writes at $3.75/M, cache reads at $0.30/M, and outputs at $15.00/M.
WHEN calculating the prompt cache hit ratio H, THE SYSTEM SHALL compute H = sum(cache_read) / sum(uncached_input + cache_creation + cache_read) * 100.0.
IF a trial execution exhibits a prompt cache hit ratio below 0.90 (90%), THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the Cache Health assertion as FAILED in eval-report@1.json.
WHEN merging pre-compaction snapshots with final transcripts, THE SYSTEM SHALL take the maximum value for each cumulative token metric rather than the sum.

WHEN building the TrajectoryGraph, THE SYSTEM SHALL run Tarjan Strongly Connected Components to identify tool cycles and flag any cycle of depth >= 3 without mutations as a CircularExplorationLoop anomaly.
IF a CircularExplorationLoop anomaly is detected in the transcript, THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the Trajectory Integrity assertion as FAILED in eval-report@1.json.
WHEN evaluating multi-agent review interactions (e.g. Drafter and Auditor), THE SYSTEM SHALL count review cycles and verify that consensus is reached in <= 2 rounds.
IF multi-agent review iterations exceed 2 rounds, THE SYSTEM SHALL emit a CircuitBreakerStall error and fail the Multi-Agent Circuit assertion.

WHEN executing a deterministic SWE-bench evaluation task, THE SYSTEM SHALL assert that the initial test runner execution FAILS before patch application and PASSES with zero regressions after patch application.
IF a test suite passes prior to patch application in a Red-to-Green task, THE SYSTEM SHALL fail the test with an InvalidRedState error.
WHEN verifying spec@1 schema artifacts, THE SYSTEM SHALL assert that every acceptance criterion follows formal EARS syntax and that all referenced structs match live AST definitions.
IF a spec@1 artifact references a function or struct not found in the target codebase, THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the AST Grounding assertion as FAILED.
WHEN executed with --offline, THE SYSTEM SHALL evaluate tasks by matching SHA-256 prompt hashes against VCR cassettes and returning frozen results in under 5ms with $0.00 network spend.
IF an offline evaluation task cannot find a matching cassette file in cassettes_dir, THE SYSTEM SHALL return a MissingCassetteError with remediation instructions.
WHEN ClaudeCliDriver is selected, THE SYSTEM SHALL spawn the local claude binary using -p and --output-format=json in non-interactive mode without requiring an API key.
IF neither a local CLI binary nor a cloud API key is found in the environment, THE SYSTEM SHALL exit with code 2 and render a miette diagnostic card explaining how to configure drivers.
WHEN executing an evaluation task, THE SYSTEM SHALL create an isolated /tmp/ sandbox and delete the temporary directory upon completion without mutating the host workspace.
WHEN parallel directory scans are executed via lumen scan, THE SYSTEM SHALL utilize rayon and memmap2 to parse session files across available CPU cores.
WHEN generating evaluation reports, THE SYSTEM SHALL format output in strict accordance with the eval-report@1 JSON schema.
WHEN executed in GitHub Actions with --github-summary, THE SYSTEM SHALL write a clean, formatted Markdown scorecard directly to the GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY environment file.
IF a session log contains corrupted, truncated, or non-UTF8 lines, THE SYSTEM SHALL skip the invalid line, log a structured warning, and continue parsing remaining lines.

WHEN prism bench --skill=<SKILL> is invoked, THE SYSTEM SHALL execute paired trials comparing the skill-augmented agent against a raw baseline LLM and calculate the delta in pass rate, tokens, and cost.
WHEN prism record --task=<TASK> is invoked, THE SYSTEM SHALL execute a live completion, strip dynamic timestamps and request IDs, and save the normalized cassette to tests/cassettes/.
WHEN calculating the Trajectory Efficiency Index E, THE SYSTEM SHALL compute E = (State Mutations + Targeted Reads Leading to Mutations) / Total Invocations.

reasoning: Synthesizes the 6,366-line Lumen specification, 2025/2026 academic and industry evaluation benchmarks (PRMs, SWE-bench Pro, Trajectory DAGs, MASEval), Anthropic prompt caching mechanics, and Callisto crate layer standards into a single, comprehensive, testable specification.
